nodes.name: Rows In
nodes.notes: Helper (Execute Workflow, passthrough, mode once). Items are Companies rows in the register's shape; the first item also carries _meta {base, clientRecId, tag, domainSource, allowNew, keys}. Counters only go back; no run-log row.

nodes.name: AT Create Columns
nodes.notes: The open-field rule: an open key becomes a singleLineText column on Companies, once per run. The Storeleads, Hiring and Reviews groups are register extras and are never created here; the scaffold owns them.

nodes.name: AT Create Lookups
nodes.notes: The same-named lookup on People through the Companies link, so every open field reads on both tables.

nodes.name: Get DNC Domains
nodes.notes: DNC at landing (ruled 2026-09-02): a domain on the client's DNC table never gets a Companies row. The read is loud; a base without a DNC table was already refused by Check Columns.

nodes.name: Read Existing
nodes.notes: Which of these domains Companies already holds, ids only, one call per 100 domains. Loud: a failed read would re-stamp Domain Source on existing rows.
